training_sources: Split training rows/forms and public lexicon only. Inner model selection rebuilds entire pipeline on fit_ids only; validation forms absent. Final fit uses full train_ids.
factual_asset_provenance: Reader, temporal windows, HMM and parse calibrator rebuilt for each pool. Probabilistic timelines include unlabelled batch hypotheses, never proof premises.

leakage_audit.detail: Feature extraction and candidate fitting run in subprocesses with sanitized runtime CSV, train-only forms or feature caches. Gold lives only in evaluator. Filesystem isolation not OS-enforced. Internal native HMM OOF hides labels but retains permitted training forms; training-feature optimism remains.

model_asset_reason: Fitted in memory, not serialized; caches and their hashes retained.

confidence.semantics: Winning-class model probability, not evidence proof. Native/most candidates uncalibrated; LinearSVC and Ridge use training-only sigmoid CV calibration.
confidence.calibration: Parse isotonic on training-only holdout; final parser refit. Candidate calibration stays in fitting pool. Preprocessing inside estimator pipelines.
confidence.selection: Highest frozen inner-validation macro F1, tie by declared candidate order. Native included; no outer-test selection.
